native_mechanisms: A single rolling sphere is the sole carried state across the whole ordered input (one accumulator, no side state, old state discarded each step).
A fixed number of tumbles down the trail (rotation/crack steps) mixes each mark into the sphere before the next mark is taken.
Only the final hairline crack in the last stalk is kept as the output token; all intermediate cracks, dust and eggshells (tail/length debris) are swept away.
core_technique: Multiply-free ARX streaming hash: each 8-byte word is added into a lane accumulator then passed through a fixed count (two) of compile-time rotate-xor bijections x ^= rotl(x,a) ^ rotl(x,b), over 4 scalar (or 8 AVX2) independent lanes, finished with 4 SipRounds and an XOR fold.
